annotations.title: Get a conference and its abstracts

description: Use this when the user asks about one meeting from list_conferences, or what was presented there. Returns its organizer, site and every edition; with `edition`, that edition's abstracts worth reading, the most relevant first, each with its number, format and the paper it was later published as. An abstract is not a peer-reviewed paper. Read one in full with get_paper.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page. Keep the other parameters the same.

edition.description: An edition from `editions`, e.g. 2025: list its abstracts.

id.description: Conference id from list_conferences, e.g. gsa.

min_visibility.description: With `edition`: which abstracts to list, from the most to the least worth reading: `core`, `visible`, `searchable`, `matchable`, `out`. Default `visible`, those worth reading.

name: get_conference
